photos.name: img-7375
photos.summary: All 12 buns fresh from oven in muffin tin — mix of 6 standard round buns and 6 cinnamon-roll swirl style. Golden brown tops, visible swirl patterns on swirl variants. Varying sizes across the batch showing the uniformity challenge.

photos.name: img-7378
photos.summary: Glazed buns — 3 on white plate in foreground, remaining batch in glass baking dish behind. Honey-soy glaze glistening, black and white sesame seeds sprinkled on top. Both swirl and round styles visible with golden glossy finish.

photos.name: img-7379
photos.summary: Crumb shot — hand tearing open a swirl bun showing yellow-orange interior from gochujang. Fluffy, pull-apart texture visible. Glazed buns in background on plate and in glass dish with sesame seeds.
